provenance.recording_note: INTENTIONAL CONTRACT CHANGE (Phase 2, RES-01). The recorded response was the pre-refactor behaviour for params[0]=1: the integer was converted straight to a native DEVHANDLE and handed to the vendor library, which answered 0x0A000026 'DisControlDev failed'. A client-supplied integer is no longer accepted as a handle at all, so the request is rejected before reaching the vendor library. This is the defect RES-01 exists to remove; the new response is the contract.
